about_the_game:
"

Elementals
 


Art by: Allen Michael N. Geneta  


Layout by: Anna Michelle Meservier 

Mythic Portal is proud to bring you Elementals in our ongoing & popular series of PC, NPC and Monster tokens.
Fill your campaign with all the power of the elemental planes. Featuring 24 beautifully drawn Elementals of every type. Fire, Water, Air, Earth, Mud, Magma, Storm, and more are available. Additionally, each token has four thematically appropriate border variants so you can find just the right style for your campaign.
As always our tokens are fully compatible with any of our  Token Essentials and One Minute Maps series. "
